name: Task Dispatch Contract
description: Define the task dispatch contract: task structure, assignment protocol, result return semantics.
purpose: Standardize the task dispatch interface so any agent can accept, execute, and return results for any task in a predictable manner.
acceptanceCriteria: Task structure is formally defined with all required and optional fields
Assignment protocol specifies how tasks are claimed and acknowledged
Result contract defines success, failure, and partial result formats
Task lifecycle states are defined (queued, assigned, running, completed, failed, cancelled)
Schema is validated at task submission and dispatch boundaries
